name: Evaluate safety risks and hazards in everyday and alarming scenarios
description: Users asked for assessments of safety risks, hazards, and precautions related to a wide range of domestic, chemical, and environmental scenarios, including concerns about minor individuals describing explosive synthesis procedures. They sought clarity on whether specific objects, materials, or actions posed immediate dangers and requested guidance on how to manage these risks or interpret alarming behavioral descriptions.
